tools.name: get_dli
tools.description: DLI — DueWall Lending Index: rules-based equal-weight NAV benchmark of grade-A tokenized credit pools, daily since 2026-10-31=100, Bitcoin-anchored, never backfilled.

tools.name: get_dcr
tools.description: DCR — DeFi Credit Rate: the Sky Savings Rate measured exactly from the on-chain sUSDS accumulator (daily series).

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Structured events for tokenized credit: D1 dated obligations (maturities, outcomes, windows), E1 on-chain redemption executions, R1 rate decisions — each record with per-field source_url and coverage grade A/B/M.

tools.name: get_upcoming_maturities
tools.description: Future-dated obligations (maturities, redemption windows) sorted by date — the forward-looking layer that is invisible on-chain. Returns nothing when the calendar is empty; that emptiness is the finding.

tools.name: get_terms
tools.description: Human-verified liquidity terms per fund: structure, liquidity frequency, settlement, min investment, fees, domicile — grade A = checked against issuer factsheets.

tools.name: get_pools
tools.description: Pool snapshot: Centrifuge pool tokens (on-chain NAV) + DefiLlama RWA TVL/APY.

tools.name: get_verification
tools.description: Claim-vs-observed verification: issuer claims checked against on-chain/document observations — three-state verdicts (consistent / discrepant / untestable), every check evidence-linked. Badges are earned, never bought.

tools.name: get_verification_log
tools.description: Append-only public verification log: daily one-row-per-day counts, delta-derived events (new discrepancies, coverage growth), open discrepancies. Verifying since 2026-11-19, Bitcoin-anchored.

tools.name: get_allowlist
tools.description: Rule-based verified-issuer allow-list for investment-policy engines: funds with grade-A human-verified terms AND zero discrepant checks. Rules-hashed, append-only history, Bitcoin-anchored. Membership changes publish with evidence - no discretionary overrides (earned, never bought).

tools.name: get_flows
tools.description: Per-fund daily NET capital flows (FLW2) from on-chain totalIssuance daily anchors: net_shares / net_usd / tvl_usd per day, plus market tape events (large executions |USD|>=1M at minute-level UTC timestamps — every issuance jump is a real subscription/redemption). Conservation-exact: sum of daily del
